tool_args.rationale: The endpoint-matched history gap and transient lag favor a coupled memory ODE. The trajectory batch provides the additional histories needed to constrain its four parameters using the irregular causal prefixes before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter coupled memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five forecast labels with similar horizons leave too little information to reliably separate memory coupling from its relaxation time.
The pilot already points to history dependence; the remaining ambiguity is parameter identification within the coupled model.

considered_alternatives.option: Snapshot balance or Maxwell stress decay
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Neither can explain different forecasts for matched endpoints with different histories.
